latest_release.name: v3.1.1
latest_release.body:
release v3.1.1

## What's Changed
* fix(frontend): enforce source SELECT privilege for postgres_query (#26862) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27218
* cherry-pick fix(meta): preserve connection and secret refs during connector alters (#26923) to release-3.1 by @maybe-vibe in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27200
* cherry-pick: feat(stream): support keyed changelog planning and execution (#27184, #27206) by @howenyap in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27252
* feat(stream): support broadcast temporal join (#26932, #27025, #27000) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27262
* fix(sink): keep the old-pk delete when an update changes the sink pk (#27417) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27419
* fix(meta): fill secrets before validating altered sink props (#27183) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27433
* fix(ci): pass merge queue base ref to paths-filter (#26273) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27435
* fix(cdc): cancel engine startup when the reader is dropped (#27418) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27444
* fix(cdc): compare MySQL schema history positions by binlog coordinates (#27391) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27405
* fix(cdc): start SQL Server sources on databases with no recent change (#27441) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27467
* fix(frontend): check CREATE privilege before fetching schema (#27513) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27527
* fix(cdc): force-close SQL Server connections on shutdown (#27186) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27336
* fix(stream): build EOWC over window eviction keys by column index (#27473) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27482
* fix(iceberg): recover compaction schedules after meta restart (#27449) by @chenzl25 in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27585
* test(ci): run inline CDC source tests serially (#26798) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27220
* fix(stream): forward buffered upstream rows when arrangement backfill finishes on a barrier (#27532) by @chenzl25 in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27589
* fix(cdc): validate SQL Server table name casing (#27411) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27503
* fix(frontend): check source privilege for CDC tables (#26912) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27219
* fix(stream): avoid throttling generate_series with now_progress_ratio (#27191) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27491
* fix(connector): restore base64 Pub/Sub source credentials (#27603) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27607
* fix(source): retry when Pulsar consumer terminates (#27505) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27516
* cherry-pick: fix(meta,stream): recover source splits and derive NOW progress from elapsed time (#27208, #27209) to release-3.1 by @wenym1 in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27333
* cherry-pick refactor(meta): shorten Hummock GC context lock scope (release-3.1) by @zwang28 in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27650
* perf(storage): avoid version waits for readable batch query epochs (#27661) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27663
* feat(meta): support database filters in diagnostic reports (#27460) by @risingwave-ci in https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave/pull/27511
* fix(meta): do not serialize secret store private key in MetaOpts (#27586) by @risingwave-ci in htt
